title: Don't let your message compete with scam texts
excerpt: The Notifier delivers alerts inside a free app people already trust – no phone number, no spam, no guessing. Free for you, free trial for organizations.
content_html:
For developers

Broadcast alerts to your users' phones without requiring their phone number.

It's ideal for:

  • Letting customers know that a new product has just dropped.
  • Letting event attendees know about a last second schedule change.
  • Letting gym members know that a trainer has open slots available today.

See for yourself

Scan the QR code or click the button.

You'll get an alert when Github has an incident – they occur more frequently nowadays so you'll likely get your first alert within a day or two.

Scan the QR code or click the button.

You'll get an alert when Indie Hackers publishes a new case study - usually one or two a week.

Just a heads-up that these alerts can fire at any time of the day.

Learn more

Vist For Developers to learn how our unique model allows you to build a privacy-focused alert system you'd want for yourself and to be notified when our API is available.
